how: Written by reading each structure and PubChem's published rules for its 3D records (at most 50 non-hydrogen atoms, one covalent unit, common organic elements), before the generator was run; never generated. 'answer' is what the 3D view should give: 'pubchem' (PubChem's 3D record), 'rdkit' (PubChem has none, so RDKit's model), 'too_big', 'no_model' (RDKit can't build it: it can't exist) or 'one_structure'. 'note' is whether the drawing leaves stereo undefined, so the panel says the model shows one arrangement (null: not judged). A test compares the generated tests/fixtures/conformers_expected.json with this file.
